entry.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
entry.summary:
Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) achieve remarkable success on diverse multimodal understanding and generation tasks, yet they still struggle to effectively leverage language-based chain-of-thought reasoning for image generation. As a result, existing reasoning-augmented UMMs often fail to inherit the test-time scaling and fine-grained controllability observed in large language models. We attribute this failure to a fundamental modality mismatch: reasoning is performed in a discrete token space, whereas image generation operates in a continuous space.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #reinforcement-learning
